info.title: Instance Cloud API: development tenant deletion
info.description: Admin-tenant Cloud API contract, separate from a tenant's Management API. This operation never removes protected system tenants, production tenants, billing resources, Kubo workloads or external storage.

delete.summary: Permanently delete an authorized development identity tenant
delete.description: Requires a signed user bearer token from the instance admin issuer, the instance Cloud API audience and manage:tenant:self (or the existing all scope), active console identity, global tenant-access eligibility and manage:tenant on the target. Machine tokens are refused. Admin/default targets are protected even for operators. Target metadata is locked and revalidated; production/unknown tags and unsafe database roles fail closed. Cleanup and a minimal operator audit record are committed in one PostgreSQL transaction. Already cached tenant instances recheck authoritative existence. Existing in-flight requests may finish. This operation is irreversible; an application rollback does not restore deleted data.

204.description: Target identity tenant, console membership and dedicated restricted role removed. No response body.

401.description: Missing or invalid user bearer token

403.description: Insufficient authorization, inactive identity, machine token or protected system target

409.description: Production/unknown tag requires billing clearance, or role metadata/capabilities are unsafe

503.description: Deletion could not be confirmed. Database/role dependency failures roll back. A connection failure during commit can leave the outcome unknown: read the tenant state before retrying. Raw database errors are not returned.
